english.note: This is the direct term for sailing or travelling all the way around the world; it is the all-purpose choice for this sense.

examples.english: This circumnavigation took a year, and the fleet finally returned to Hong Kong.
examples.traditional: 呢次環球航行歷時一年，船隊終於返抵香港。
